$description: AVAN GROUP · A4.3 Complex Components (Organisms) · Component tier (W3C DTCG). Resolves the placeholders named in the A4.3 matrix into concrete entries for the seven organisms: data-table, modal, drawer, datepicker, chart, navigation, stepper. References avan-color-tokens.json, avan-spacing-tokens.json, avan-motion-tokens.json, avan-state-tokens.json, avan-molecule-tokens.json. Organism tokens compose molecules and atoms into full surfaces; they never restate an atom's internals. Each performance target from the matrix is bound here to a concrete duration/easing/budget token so the contract is enforceable, not aspirational. rgba overlays and casts that have no global alias are stated raw with lineage in $description, per house convention.

table.$description: 10,000 rows virtualized · windowed render, fixed row height, sticky header on the ink rail.

header-bg.$description: #0E1722 — sticky header band; sits above scrolling body on the inverse rail

header-text.$description: label-cased column heads on the dark header

row-hover-bg.$description: #FBF5EC — full-row hover wash; pointer only, never on touch

row-selected-bg.$description: bronze.500 at 12% — checkbox selection tint; co-exists with hover

border-color.$description: bronze.500 at 28% — cell + column rule; hairline weight

border-width.$description: single device pixel; never scales with density

row-height.$description: 44px — fixed; the constant that makes windowing math exact

row-height-compact.$description: 36px density mode; still ≥ touch target via hit-slop

resize-handle.$description: column-resize grip, shown on header hover; 6px hit-slop

sort-indicator.$description: active sort caret; direction conveyed by aria-sort too

virtualize-threshold.$description: rows above which windowing engages; below this the table renders in full

virtualize-overscan.$description: rows rendered beyond viewport each side; absorbs fast-scroll without blank flashes

modal.$description: <100ms open · compositor-only entrance (opacity + scale), no layout on the critical path. Focus trap + scroll lock are structural, not animated.

backdrop-bg.$description: ink.950 at 58% — scrim; dismiss-on-click unless the dialog is blocking

shadow.$description: Deeper than {shadow.5}; reserved for the modal layer only

enter-duration.$description: 200ms visual settle — runs AFTER first paint; never gates the <100ms open contract

enter-easing.$description: weighted decelerate for the deliberate arrival

exit-duration.$description: 100ms — leaves faster than it enters, on {easing.accelerate}

drawer.$description: 60fps swipe · transform-only tracking (translateX), no width/left animation. Scrim fades on opacity in parallel.

scrim-bg.$description: ink.950 at 48% — lighter than modal; the drawer is less blocking

shadow.$description: Horizontal cast for the right anchor; mirror X for left anchor

swipe-close-threshold.$description: fraction of width dragged past which release commits the close

swipe-velocity-commit.$description: px/ms flick velocity that commits close regardless of distance

track-easing.$description: applied only to the release-snap, not to finger tracking (which is 1:1)

frame-budget.$description: per-frame ceiling for the 60fps target; transform + opacity stay on the compositor

datepicker.$description: Keyboard navigable · roving tabindex across the day grid; arrows move, Enter selects, Home/End jump week ends.

selected-bg.$description: #141E2D — chosen day; cream text for contrast

today-ring.$description: 1px ring marking today; independent of selection

cell-size.$description: 44px tap/click cell; grid is 7 × cell-size. Fixed 2026-06-24 audit: previously hardcoded 2.25rem (36px), below the system touch-target floor with no documented hit-slop exception.

cell-radius.$description: 3px; range fill stays rectangular between caps

chart.$description: Per A4.3 §6 — categorical series palette ordered for color-blind separability (luminance-stepped, never hue-only). Every chart ships a data-table alternative; color is never the sole encoder.

8.$description: #D4BD9A — beyond 8 series, switch to small-multiples not more hues

grid-line.$description: bronze.500 at 18% — axis + gridlines; recede behind data

skeleton-bg.$description: bronze.500 at 10% — loading shimmer base; linear easing only

nav.$description: Collapse <300ms · width animates on {easing.standard}; rail content cross-fades, never reflows mid-transition. Distinct from molecule nav-item tokens, which govern a single item's states.

border-color.$description: bronze.500 at 20% — rail edge + breadcrumb separators on the dark surface

breadcrumb-separator.$description: cream at 40% — chevron glyph between crumbs

tab-indicator.$description: 2px underline on the active tab; slides between tabs on {easing.in-out}

megamenu-bg.$description: mega-menu panel drops onto the light surface, not the rail

stepper.$description: Step transition 200ms · panel cross-fade + 16px slide on {easing.standard}; the rail node states update instantly (state is truth, motion is garnish).

active-color.$description: #A8895C — current step node + connector up to it

active-ring.$description: bronze.500 at 24% — focus/active halo on the current node

completed-color.$description: #2B5F43 — passed steps; check glyph, not just fill

node-size.$description: 28px circle; label sits beside or below

transition-slide.$description: 16px enter offset; dropped under reduced motion
